URLs provided link to v2 feather files required for the 0.12.1 version of pySENIC.  curl "https://resources.aertslab.org/cistarget/databases/homo_sapiens/hg38/refseq_r80/mc_v10_clust/gene_based/hg38_10kbp_up_10kbp_down_full_tx_v10_clust.genes_vs_motifs.rankings.feather" \   -o "${SCENIC_DIR}/hg38_10kbp_up_10kbp_down_full_tx_v10_clust.genes_vs_motifs.rankings.feather"  curl "https://resources.aertslab.org/cistarget/databases/homo_sapiens/hg38/refseq_r80/mc_v10_clust/gene_based/hg38_500bp_up_100bp_down_full_tx_v10_clust.genes_vs_motifs.rankings.feather" \   -o "${SCENIC_DIR}/hg38_500bp_up_100bp_down_full_tx_v10_clust.genes_vs_motifs.rankings.feather"  # List of genes encoding TFs in the hg38 reference genome curl "https://resources.aertslab.org/cistarget/tf_lists/allTFs_hg38.txt" \   -o "${SCENIC_DIR}/allTFs_hg38.txt"  # Motif annotations based on the 2017 cisTarget motif collection. title: SCENIC for TF Activity Scoring
text: examples use pbmc SingleCellExperiment object input_dir directory created Get Started vignette. dominoSignal designed compatible single cell workflows, accepting gene cell matrices counts scaled counts. However, pySCENIC used TF activity inference, requires input cell gene matrix. opposite orientation many R based single cell packages (Seurat SingleCellExperiment) default Python based tools scanpy. RNA counts matrix can saved tab-separated value (.tsv) comma-separated value (.csv) file transposing matrix cell gene orientation. example extracting counts SingleCellExperiment object saving .tsv file. TSV CSV files inefficient storing large matrices. alternative, counts matrix can saved loom file directly passed pySCENIC format. Generating loom file R requires use loomR package. package automatically handles transposition counts matrix cell gene orientation well. recommend approach passing counts matrix pySCENIC. However, users aware loomR hosted CRAN Bioconductor time vignette’s creation. use pbmc3k\_counts.loom file tutorial. Copy link ${SCENIC_DIR} following steps.
code: pbmc_counts <- assay(pbmc, "counts") write.table(t(as.matrix(pbmc_counts)), paste0(input_dir, "/pbmc3k_counts.tsv"), sep = "\t",     col.names = NA) library(loomR)  # save loom counts matrix pbmc_counts <- assay(pbmc, "counts") pbmc_loom <- loomR::create(filename = paste0(input_dir, "/pbmc3k_counts.loom"), data = pbmc_counts) # Depending on the version of loomR, you may need to manually add CellID and # Gene attributes: pbmc_loom$add.row.attribute(list(Gene = rownames(pbmc))) pbmc_loom$add.col.attribute(list(CellID = colnames(pbmc)))  # connection to the loom file must be closed to complete file creation pbmc_loom$close_all()

title: Cell Communication from Single Cell RNA Sequencing Data
text: dominoSignal infers intra- intercellular signaling single cell RNA sequencing (scRNAseq) data. Within cell cluster, identifies transcription factors (TFs) enriched activity links receptors whose expression correlates activity. connects active receptors ligands expressed clusters, producing cluster--cluster signaling network associated downstream transcriptional response rather ligand receptor expression alone. dominoSignal builds original domino R package (Cherry et al., 2021, Nature Biomedical Engineering) adds Differential Cell Signaling Test (DCST) statistically comparing signaling across subjects conditions (Mitchell et al., 2026, Bioinformatics).
